description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object for filtering employee leave entitlement and usage reports. It extends a date range filter class and includes properties and methods to specify employee number, report type, and sorting fields, with validation for report type.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filters in employee leave entitlement and usage reports, including employee number, report type, and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a default sort field 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Returns the current report type ('employee' or 'my').

methods.name: setReportType
methods.description: Sets the report type, validating that it is either 'employee' or 'my'; throws InvalidArgumentException otherwise.
